services.title: Four ways we put AI to work
services.sub: Most studios sell hours. We sell outcomes — packaged into four depths of engagement so you only buy what you need.
services.l1Desc: Hook your team into ChatGPT, Claude or local models with disciplined prompts and guardrails.
services.l2Desc: Embed AI into your day-to-day — sales, ops, support — via n8n or custom orchestration.
services.l3Desc: Agents with tools, memory and your knowledge base. One company, one toolset.
services.l4Desc: Fine-tuning, retrieval pipelines, private deployment when off-the-shelf isn't enough.
services.pageSub: From a single prompt library to a privately deployed model — pick the depth that matches your problem.

custom.title: We own the whole journey
custom.discoveryDesc: We interview your team, map the workflow, and write the spec with you — before any code.
custom.buildDesc: Weekly demos. Your Git repo. Milestone-based payment so you never pay for vapor.

customDev.title: Classic software, built properly
customDev.sub: AI is our edge, not our only trade. We've shipped traditional custom software for a decade — the AI just makes it faster and cheaper for you.

customDev.c2d: iOS and Android from one codebase, App Store submission included.
customDev.c3d: ERPs, dashboards, approval flows — kill the spreadsheet sprawl.
customDev.c4d: Make your existing tools talk to each other: payments, logistics, CRMs, anything with an API.
